title: Plurals
explanation:
A noun ending in a vowel usually adds -s: casa, casas. A noun ending in a consonant usually adds -es: tren, trenes. A final -z becomes -ces: lápiz, lápices.

The article changes with the noun. Los is masculine plural. Las is feminine plural.
commonMistake: Adding -es to a noun that already ends in a vowel, as in libroes, or keeping a singular article with a plural noun.
